# Generated by velnor-workflow. Regenerate; do not hand-edit.
name: Release
run-name: Release · ${{ github.ref_name }}

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      providers:
        description: Comma-separated provider subset (release publishes from github-hosted)
        required: false
        default: github-hosted
        type: string
      existing-image-digest:
        description: Exact OCI index digest for an explicitly verified failed-run recovery.
        type: string
        required: false
        default: ''

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  admit-provider:
    name: Control / Admit release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Reject Velnor-only native release
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.providers != '' && !contains(format(',{0},', github.event.inputs.providers), ',github-hosted,') }}
        run: |
          echo 'native release publishes from GitHub only; Velnor-only dispatch is unsupported' >&2
          exit 1
      - name: Reject local providers on tag dispatch
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref_type == 'tag' && (contains(format(',{0},', github.event.inputs.providers), ',velnor,') || contains(format(',{0},', github.event.inputs.providers), ',github-self-hosted,')) }}
        run: |
          echo 'tag dispatch publishes github-hosted only; use a tag push for full provider scope' >&2
          exit 1
      - name: Declare release provider scope
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
        env:
          PROVIDERS: ${{ github.event.inputs.providers }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          scope="${PROVIDERS:-github-hosted}"
          echo "release provider scope: $scope"
          case ",$scope," in
            *,velnor,*|*,github-self-hosted,*) echo 'full provider scope includes local lanes' ;;
            *) echo '::notice::BOOTSTRAP release scope: github-hosted only (local qualification deferred)' ;;
          esac

  verify:
    name: Control / Verify release
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Velnor workflow runtime
        id: runtime
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-velnor-workflow
        with:
          rev: 0dc79895ff1c5e88be7c3822c437e1c5b5282e12
      - name: Set trusted workflow policy revision
        run: echo "VELNOR_WORKFLOW_POLICY_REVISION=0dc79895ff1c5e88be7c3822c437e1c5b5282e12" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Enforce workflow policy
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: velnor-workflow policy --workflow-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
      - name: Set up sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@fc920bf0ec8de6ee65d409111f7ec508035751ba # v0.0.11
        with:
          version: v0.16.0
      - name: Verify tag
        run: velnor-workflow release verify-tag --branch 'main' --package 'velnor-runner'
      - name: Resolve release version
        id: version
        env:
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$TAG" in
            v[0-9]*) ;;
            *) echo "::error::release tag $TAG must match v[0-9]*" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          version="${TAG#v}"
          case "$version" in
            ''|*['/ ']*) echo "::error::release version is not portable: $version" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
      - name: Restore "Bun package (velnor)" cache
        id: cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.bun/install/cache
          key: ci-release-${{ runner.os }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-bun-velnor-${{ hashFiles('package.json', 'bun.lock') }}
      - name: Plan full release selection
        env:

          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          VELNOR_SELECTION_FILE: .velnor-ci-selection/velnor-ci-selection
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .velnor-ci-selection
          velnor-workflow plan --config .github/ci/project.toml

      - name: Run "Bun package (velnor)" checks
        env:
          CI_SCOPE: full
          CI_UNIT_ID: bun-velnor
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"
          MISE_EXEC_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"
          MISE_NOT_FOUND_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"
        run: velnor-workflow run --config .github/ci/project.toml --scope "$CI_SCOPE" --unit bun-velnor

  release-github-hosted-docker:
    name: "github-hosted / Docker / docker"

  release-github-hosted-rust-policy:
    name: "github-hosted / Rust / rust-policy"
    needs: [verify]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Velnor workflow runtime

        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-velnor-workflow

          rev: 0dc79895ff1c5e88be7c3822c437e1c5b5282e12
      - name: Set trusted workflow policy revision
        run: echo "VELNOR_WORKFLOW_POLICY_REVISION=0dc79895ff1c5e88be7c3822c437e1c5b5282e12" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Restore Rust toolchain
        id: rustup-toolchain
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.rustup
          key: velnor-rustup-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('rust-toolchain.toml', 'rust-toolchain') }}
      - name: Provision Rust toolchain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install
          rustup target add 'aarch64-apple-darwin' 'aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu' 'x86_64-apple-darwin' 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu' 'x86_64-unknown-linux-musl'
      - name: Bound the Mr. Boxington store
        shell: bash
        run: echo "MBX_GC_MAX_SIZE=12GiB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Set up Mr. Boxington
        id: mbx-cache
        uses: jdx/mr-boxington-action@a20e1ffcd962370fb2b6045c13b7b349f7b03386 # v1.3.1
        with:
          backend: github
          github-cache-mode: objects
          version: 1.11.1
          cache-key: velnor-mbx-v3-ec62b8b58bab-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-rust-policy-${{ hashFiles('.cargo/**', 'Cargo.lock', 'deny.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('.cargo/audit.toml', '.cargo/deny.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'audit.toml', 'deny.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            velnor-mbx-v3-ec62b8b58bab-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-rust-policy-${{ hashFiles('.cargo/**', 'Cargo.lock', 'deny.toml') }}-
            velnor-mbx-v3-ec62b8b58bab-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-rust-policy-
          save-on-workflow-dispatch: true
      - name: Restore cargo bin toolchain
        id: cargo-bin-toolchain
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/bin
          key: velnor-cargo-bin-v2-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('mise.lock', 'mise.toml') }}
      - name: Verify cargo bin tools
        if: ${{ steps.cargo-bin-toolchain.outputs.cache-hit == 'true' }}
        id: cargo-bin-verify
        shell: bash
        env:
          CARGO_BIN_TOOLS: cargo-deny
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          missing=0
          IFS=',' read -ra tools <<< "$CARGO_BIN_TOOLS"
          for tool in "${tools[@]}"; do
            tool="${tool#"${tool%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
            tool="${tool%"${tool##*[![:space:]]}"}"
            [[ -z "$tool" ]] && continue
            if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null; then
              missing=1
              break
            fi
            if ! "$tool" --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              missing=1
              break
            fi
            if [[ "$tool" == cargo-* ]]; then
              subcommand="${tool#cargo-}"
              if ! cargo "$subcommand" --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                missing=1
                break
              fi
            fi
          done
          echo "missing=$missing" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Set up cargo bin tools
        if: ${{ steps.cargo-bin-toolchain.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' || steps.cargo-bin-verify.outputs.missing == 'true' }}
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@0758d235715de2f3551eacc980d9ae8fce9342c3 # v2.87.3
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny
          fallback: none
      - name: Restore mold 2.42.0 cache
        id: mold-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/velnor/mold/2.42.0
          key: velnor-mold-2.42.0-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
      - name: Set up mold 2.42.0
        shell: bash
        env:
          MOLD_VERSION: 2.42.0
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            x86_64) mold_arch=x86_64; expected='f5ed2f6e31d1ada4f07fe766fe0de7a73104d1c5cdc59086fcecc16a43720b6d' ;;
            aarch64) mold_arch=aarch64; expected='3c9a0a3624aac8a2007569ae50c33b3129a0f0ae8bcc974aeee2f8939d295190' ;;
            *) echo "unsupported mold architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          cache_dir="$HOME/.cache/velnor/mold/$MOLD_VERSION"
          archive="$cache_dir/mold-$MOLD_VERSION-$mold_arch-linux.tar.gz"
          mkdir -p "$cache_dir"
          if [[ ! -s "$archive" ]]; then
            temporary="$archive.download"
            trap 'rm -f "$temporary"' EXIT
            curl --fail --show-error --silent --location --http1.1 --continue-at - --retry 20 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 --retry-max-time 1800 --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 900 \
              --output "$temporary" \
              "https://github.com/rui314/mold/releases/download/v$MOLD_VERSION/mold-$MOLD_VERSION-$mold_arch-linux.tar.gz"
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$expected" "$temporary" | sha256sum --check --strict
            mv "$temporary" "$archive"
            trap - EXIT
          fi
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$expected" "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
          if [[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]]; then
            tar --directory /usr/local --strip-components=1 --no-overwrite-dir -xzf "$archive"
          else
            sudo tar --directory /usr/local --strip-components=1 --no-overwrite-dir -xzf "$archive"
          fi
          command -v mold >/dev/null
          mold --version | grep -F "$MOLD_VERSION"
      - name: Restore "Rust dependency policy" cache
        id: cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ci-release-${{ runner.os }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-rust-policy-${{ hashFiles('.cargo/**', 'Cargo.lock', 'deny.toml') }}
      - name: Plan full release selection
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          VELNOR_SELECTION_FILE: .velnor-ci-selection/velnor-ci-selection
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .velnor-ci-selection
          velnor-workflow plan --config .github/ci/project.toml

      - name: Run "Rust dependency policy" checks
        env:
          CI_SCOPE: full
          CI_UNIT_ID: rust-policy
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"
          MISE_EXEC_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"
          MISE_NOT_FOUND_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"
        run: velnor-workflow run --config .github/ci/project.toml --scope "$CI_SCOPE" --unit rust-policy

  release-github-hosted-rust-unit-collector:

      - name: Set up Mr. Boxington

          : > SHA256SUMS
          : > assets.jsonl
          for subject in "${subjects[@]}"; do
            name=$(basename "$subject")
            digest=$(sha256sum "$subject" | awk '{print $1}')
            sidecar="$(awk 'NF {print $1; exit}' "${subject}.sha256")"
            [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && "$sidecar" = "$digest" ]] \
              || { echo "::error::$name sidecar does not match its payload" >&2; exit 1; }
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$name" >> SHA256SUMS
            jq -cn --arg name "$name" --arg sha256 "$digest" '{name:$name,sha256:$sha256}' >> assets.jsonl
          done
          test "$(wc -l < SHA256SUMS | tr -d ' ')" -eq 4
          (cd artifacts && sha256sum --check --strict ../SHA256SUMS)
      - name: Assemble consumer release manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq -S -n \
            --arg schema 'velnor.package-release.v1' \
            --arg source_repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --arg source_ref "$SOURCE_REF" \
            --arg source_commit "$SOURCE_COMMIT" \
            --arg version "$VERSION" \
            --slurpfile assets assets.jsonl \
            '{schema:$schema,source_repository:$source_repository,source_ref:$source_ref,source_commit:$source_commit,version:$version,assets:$assets}' \
            > release-manifest.json
      - name: Stage package subjects for hosted signer
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir signer-input
          cp artifacts/velnor-runner-*.tar.gz artifacts/velnor-runner-*.deb signer-input/
      - name: Verify packaged runner identity before release creation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for arch in amd64 arm64; do
            deb="artifacts/velnor-runner-${VERSION}-${arch}.deb"
            record_bin="$(jq -er --arg arch "$arch" '
              [.architectures[] | select(.arch == $arch)]
              | if length == 1 then .[0].binary_sha256 else error("record must contain exactly one architecture") end
            ' release-record.json)"
            case "$record_bin" in
              *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "::error::record has invalid runner binary sha256 ($arch)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
            [ "${#record_bin}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "::error::record has invalid runner binary sha256 ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
            packaged_binary_sha="$(dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile "$deb" | tar -xOf - ./usr/bin/velnor-runner | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
            [ "$packaged_binary_sha" = "$record_bin" ] || {
              echo "::error::packaged /usr/bin/velnor-runner digest != release record ($arch)" >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@37fe631027851001ddb9b187196cc803df7f5f0e # v4.3.0
        with:
          cleanup: false
      - name: Log in to GHCR for immutable image verification
        uses: docker/login-action@dbcb813823bdd20940b903addbd779551569679f # v4.6.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Verify OCI index stayed immutable before publication
        env:
          EXPECTED_INDEX_DIGEST: ${{ needs.image.outputs.index_digest }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker buildx imagetools inspect "${GHCR_IMAGE}:${VERSION}" --format '{{json .}}' > published-image.json
          published_index="$(jq -er '.manifest.digest' published-image.json)"
          [ "$published_index" = "$EXPECTED_INDEX_DIGEST" ] || {
            echo "::error::OCI version tag moved from $EXPECTED_INDEX_DIGEST to $published_index before release publication" >&2
            exit 1
          }
      - name: Verify release tag stayed immutable before publication
        env:
          EXPECTED_TAG_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          EXPECTED_TAG_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          remote_tag_refs="$(git ls-remote --exit-code origin "$EXPECTED_TAG_REF" "$EXPECTED_TAG_REF^{}")"
          remote_tag_commit="$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tag_refs" | awk -v expected="$EXPECTED_TAG_REF" '
            $2 == expected "^{}" { peeled=$1; found_peeled=1; next }
            $2 == expected && !found_peeled { raw=$1 }
            END {
              if (found_peeled) print peeled
              else if (raw != "") print raw
            }
          ')"
          case "$remote_tag_commit" in
            *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "::error::release tag $EXPECTED_TAG_REF did not resolve to lowercase hex" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          [ "${#remote_tag_commit}" -eq 40 ] || { echo "::error::release tag $EXPECTED_TAG_REF did not resolve to one commit" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$remote_tag_commit" = "$EXPECTED_TAG_COMMIT" ] || {
            echo "::error::release tag $EXPECTED_TAG_REF moved from $EXPECTED_TAG_COMMIT to $remote_tag_commit" >&2
            exit 1
          }
      - name: Create release once — no clobber, record-verified idempotency
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="v${VERSION}"
          # Fail (never mint at main HEAD) if there is nothing to publish.
          [ -f release-record.json ] || { echo "::error::no assembled record" >&2; exit 1; }
          if gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Existing release: rebuilds are NOT bit-reproducible (tar/deb/OCI
            # payloads embed build metadata), so byte-equality against a fresh
            # build can never hold and re-runs would fail forever. Instead
            # verify the PUBLISHED release is coherent: its record names this
            # exact tag/commit/version/manifest and every published asset
            # matches the digests inside that record. Never clobber (N-immutable).
            tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
            for name in release-record.json \
                        release-record.json.sha256 \
                        release-manifest.json \
                        manifest.json \
                        manifest.json.sha256 \
                        SHA256SUMS \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256" \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256" \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-amd64.deb" \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-amd64.deb.sha256" \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-arm64.deb" \
                        "velnor-runner-${VERSION}-arm64.deb.sha256"; do
              gh release download "$tag" --pattern "$name" --dir "$tmp" --clobber >/dev/null 2>&1 \
                || { echo "::error::release $tag exists but is missing $name — refusing partial overwrite" >&2; exit 1; }
            done
            # Sidecar checksums must match their payloads.
            read_sha() {
              local path="$1" size token
              [ -f "$path" ] || { echo "::error::missing checksum sidecar: $path" >&2; return 1; }
              size="$(stat -c%s "$path")"
              [ "$size" -le 4096 ] || { echo "::error::checksum sidecar exceeds 4096 bytes: $path" >&2; return 1; }
              token="$(awk '
                {
                  for (field = 1; field <= NF; field++) {
                    token_count++
                    if (token_count == 1) token = $field
                  }
                }
                END {
                  if (token_count != 1) exit 1
                  print token
                }
              ' "$path")" || { echo "::error::checksum sidecar must contain one token: $path" >&2; return 1; }
              [ "${#token}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "::error::invalid checksum sidecar: $path" >&2; return 1; }
              case "$token" in
                *[!0-9a-f]*) echo "::error::invalid checksum sidecar: $path" >&2; return 1 ;;
              esac
              printf '%s\n' "$token"
            }
            [ "$(read_sha "$tmp/release-record.json.sha256")" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/release-record.json" | awk '{print $1}')" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published release-record.json fails its sidecar checksum" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(read_sha "$tmp/manifest.json.sha256")" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/manifest.json" | awk '{print $1}')" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published manifest.json fails its sidecar checksum" >&2; exit 1; }
            # The record must name this exact tag, source commit, crate version
            # and the manifest this source tree compiles to (the compiled
            # manifest is byte-reproducible; binaries are not).
            [ "$(jq -r '.build.tag' "$tmp/release-record.json")" = "$tag" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published record tag mismatch — refusing to touch $tag" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(jq -r '.build.commit' "$tmp/release-record.json")" = "$COMMIT" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published record commit mismatch — tag may have moved" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(jq -r '.build.crate_version' "$tmp/release-record.json")" = "$VERSION" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published record version mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(jq -r '.build.manifest_sha256' "$tmp/release-record.json")" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/manifest.json" | awk '{print $1}')" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published record/manifest incoherent" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(jq -r '.build.manifest_sha256' "$tmp/release-record.json")" = "$MANIFEST_SHA256" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published record manifest != manifest compiled from $COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
            expected_oci_index="$(jq -er '.oci_index_digest' "$tmp/release-record.json")"
            [ "$expected_oci_index" = "$INDEX_DIGEST" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published record OCI index != current release image" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(jq -r '.oci_image_ref' "$tmp/release-record.json")" = "${GHCR_IMAGE}@${expected_oci_index}" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published record OCI reference is not digest-pinned" >&2; exit 1; }
            # Every published package asset must match the record's digests.
            (cd "$tmp" && sha256sum --check --strict SHA256SUMS)
            for tuple in 'amd64 x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu' 'arm64 aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu'; do
              read -r arch target <<<"$tuple"
              tarball="velnor-runner-${VERSION}-${target}.tar.gz"
              deb="velnor-runner-${VERSION}-${arch}.deb"
              record_deb="$(jq -r --arg arch "$arch" '.architectures[] | select(.arch == $arch) | .deb_sha256' "$tmp/release-record.json")"
              record_bin="$(jq -r --arg arch "$arch" '.architectures[] | select(.arch == $arch) | .binary_sha256' "$tmp/release-record.json")"
              [ "$(read_sha "$tmp/${tarball}.sha256")" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/$tarball" | awk '{print $1}')" ] \
                || { echo "::error::published tarball fails its sidecar checksum ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
              [ "$(read_sha "$tmp/${deb}.sha256")" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/$deb" | awk '{print $1}')" ] \
                || { echo "::error::published deb fails its sidecar checksum ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
              [ "$(sha256sum "$tmp/$deb" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$record_deb" ] \
                || { echo "::error::published deb digest != record ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
              mkdir -p "$tmp/extract-$arch"
              tar -xzf "$tmp/$tarball" -C "$tmp/extract-$arch"
              [ "$(sha256sum "$tmp/extract-$arch/velnor-runner" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$record_bin" ] \
                || { echo "::error::published binary digest != record ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
            done
            # Already-published path verifies only and uploads nothing:
            # attestation stays in the build/sign jobs over the fresh-build
            # subjects staged above, never post-publish here.
            echo "Release $tag already published; record + assets verified coherent. Nothing to upload."
          else
            gh release create "$tag" --verify-tag --target "$COMMIT" --title "$tag" --generate-notes \
              release-record.json \
              release-record.json.sha256 \
              manifest.json \
              manifest.json.sha256 \
              release-manifest.json \
              SHA256SUMS \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256 \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256 \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-amd64.deb \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-amd64.deb.sha256 \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-arm64.deb \
              artifacts/velnor-runner-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}-arm64.deb.sha256
          fi
          # NOTE (N6): this workflow deliberately does NOT push to tailrocks/velnor-apt or
          # dispatch its publish. tailrocks/velnor-apt pulls this record itself
          # and verifies it before reprepro. No APT credential exists here.
      - name: Upload package subjects
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: package-subjects
          path: signer-input
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 2
